summary: First-finish smoke test of LexKasa (backend + frontend). Full happy-path flow verified end-to-end: login -> 4 seeded kasalar -> create client -> client_to_kasa avans -> kasa->kasa virman -> expense -> receivable -> partial collection -> reports/ledger. All balances mathematically consistent (Merkez 4500, Banka 1000; client balance 4700 after -300 expense; receivable remaining 1200 from 2000).
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns JWT (field name is 'token', not 'access_token') + user object
GET /api/kasalar returns 4 pre-seeded vaults (Merkez, Banka, Emanet, Icra)
POST /api/clients creates client with balance 0
POST /api/transfers/client (direction=client_to_kasa) increases kasa and client balances by 5000
POST /api/transfers/kasa moves 1000 from source_kasa_id to target_kasa_id (source-1000, target+1000)
POST /api/expenses records expense with expense_type; kasa decreases by 300
POST /api/receivables creates receivable with fee_type=akdi, total_amount=2000, remaining=2000 initial
POST /api/receivables/{id}/collect partial 800 -> remaining 1200, kasa +800, status still 'acik'
GET /api/reports/summary returns total_balance 5500, income 5800, expense 300, kasa_balances, trend
GET /api/transactions returns 4 transactions with type/amount/kasa_name/client_name
Frontend /giris login form works (login-email-input, login-password-input, 'Oturumu Ac' button) and redirects to /
Dashboard renders 4 vault cards with correct balances and 'Hos geldiniz' toast
open-vault-transfer-modal-btn opens Kasa Arasi Virman modal with Kaynak/Hedef selects
open-client-transfer-modal-btn present on dashboard
/muvekkiller shows client list with correct 4.700 balance for Test Muvekkil; open-new-client-modal-btn present
/masraflar open-new-expense-modal-btn present
/alacaklar shows receivable with 'Acik' status, 1.200 remaining, 'Tahsil Et' button present
/raporlar shows KPI cards (5500/5800/300/1200), gelir-gider line chart, kasa bar chart, CSV/Excel download button
/hareketler ledger shows all 4 transactions with type badges (Vekalet Tahsilati/Dava Masrafi/Kasa Virmani/Muvekkilden Tahsilat) and color-coded amounts
No console errors captured during navigation across pages

failed.area: Backend API contract vs review spec
failed.issue: Field names in review request do not match actual API: /transfers/kasa expects source_kasa_id/target_kasa_id (not from/to); /expenses requires expense_type field; /receivables uses total_amount (not amount); auth response uses 'token' (not 'access_token'). Frontend integrations still work since UI uses the actual contract.
failed.evidence: Pydantic 422 errors when using review-spec field names; frontend UI displays correct data end-to-end

failed.issue: Query param 'tx_type=expense' returned 0 results while transactions exist. Backend transaction records use field name 'type' (values like 'receivable_collection'), not 'tx_type'. Filter parameter likely expects different value or param name.

action_items: Optional: document actual API field names (source_kasa_id/target_kasa_id, expense_type, total_amount, 'token') in PRD to match implementation.
Optional: verify /api/transactions tx_type filter parameter; either rename to 'type' or map values (expense, income, transfer) internally.
